# Coded local development fees vs the Handbook's $50,000

<!-- GENERATED by `uv run python scripts/dev/fee_levels_table.py --out docs/research/fee-levels-vs-handbook.md`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Fee per new unit in **2025 dollars**, from `config/fees/<st>.csv` under the rules in `src/lotline/model/fee_levels.py` (D-065, D-066): per fee component the newest schedule year plus older rows still in force; a range where a fee varies by area, basin, tier or plat date; missing building-permit and water/sewer charges filled from the median of coded places (state if at least 5, else pooled), with the 25th–75th percentile as the range. The Handbook's benchmark assumes **$50,000** per unit everywhere (D-065 reads it as 2025 dollars). Places marked † are holdouts for other tests; their fees are inputs, not outcomes.
